title: Jobbland.se Scraper
description: Scrape structured job listings from JobbSafari (formerly Jobbland.se). Provide a JobbSafari search URL or use a keyword and location.

url.title: JobbSafari URL
url.description: A JobbSafari search URL, for example a general, city, category, profession, company, or paginated URL.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword. When supplied with a location, the URL input is ignored.

location.title: Location
location.description: City or area slug, for example Stockholm, Goteborg, Malmo, or Uppsala. When supplied with a keyword, the URL input is ignored.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of jobs to collect.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap for API result pages. JobbSafari returns up to 30 jobs per page.

includeDescriptions.title: Include descriptions
includeDescriptions.description: Fetch full descriptions and rich job details. Off by default. When enabled, adds one detail request per job through Apify residential proxy (Sweden) and incurs proxy cost.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings for the listing API. Descriptions use Apify residential proxy (Sweden) automatically.
